query: All four collective members gave their positions on entering the Shoreditch Photo House group show. What was each person's stance and reason?
gold: Diane was immediately enthusiastic: she had a whole Peckham set ready and was 'so in' — she wants deadlines and external validation. Luca declined: his Clyde series 'isn't ready' and six weeks won't change that; he won't submit work he's not behind. Raj was tentative: he had been on commercial shoots all month and offered to pull something from his older Karachi archive series if the theme fit — new work was not available. Anika was in favour as the proposer and reviewing others' submissions — she planned to enter and manage the collective's submission.
context:
[1] (about=Anika, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T18:44:00) Open call from Shoreditch Photo House, group show, theme is Urban Friction. Submission deadline in six weeks. I think we should enter as a collective. Thoughts.
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T18:51:00) Yes! I have a whole set from Peckham that fits this perfectly 📷 I'm so in
[3] (about=Anika, core, t0 @2025-09-01T18:44:00) Thinks the group should enter the Shoreditch Photo House open call as a collective.
[4] (about=Anika, core, t3 @2025-09-15T15:11:00) The group show went well; Diane's print got two comments in the guest book; Raj's Karachi work was the anchor.
[5] (about=Diane, said_by=Anika, profile, t2 @2025-09-08T20:25:00) Anika thinks Diane's sixth Peckham photograph is the one to submit because the fourth is mood but the sixth has consequence; the bus stop reflection makes the whole frame unstable.
[6] (about=Diane, core, t2 @2025-09-08T20:25:00) Wanted to submit the fourth photograph from Peckham set; considered submitting both.
[7] (about=Raj, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T19:19:00) I've been in the studio all month, commercial stuff. I can pull something from the Karachi series if the theme fits. Let me look at it again.
agent_answer:
- **Anika** – Stance: in favor; she proposed entering as a collective. Reason: Shoreditch Photo House has an open call for a group show with the theme “Urban Friction,” and the deadline is six weeks away.

- **Diane** – Stance: strongly in favor (“I’m so in”). Reason: she has a whole set from Peckham that fits the theme perfectly. (She later specifically wanted to submit the fourth Peckham photo, considering submitting both, but that concerns which image, not whether to enter.)

- **Raj** – Stance: open to participating but not yet committed. Reason: he has been busy with commercial studio work all month, but he can pull something from his Karachi series if the theme fits, and he wants to look at it again.

- **Luca** – There is no information available in the conversation to answer this question about Luca’s stance or reason.
